title: Spring 2027 class start
text: For the standard Spring 2027 semester, classes begin Monday, January 11, 2027.

title: Summer 2027 add/drop
text: For the standard Summer 2027 semester, classes and the add/drop period begin June 1, 2027. June 5, 2027 is the last day to add a class or drop it without an enrollment record.

title: Summer 2027 withdrawal
text: For the standard Summer 2027 semester, the course withdrawal period begins June 7, 2027 and ends July 3, 2027.

title: Adding and dropping courses
text: The catalog directs semester students to the Academic Calendar for the add/drop deadline. Adding a course depends on available space. The catalog has a separate policy for Pro+ programs.
section: Catalog p. 54, Adding and Dropping Courses

title: Academic Advising and Records
text: SFBU's Contact Us page lists records@sfbu.edu for Academic Advising and the Records Office. It identifies Records as the contact for transcripts, diplomas, and education verification.

title: IT Support
text: SFBU lists AskIT@sfbu.edu for IT Support. Use the AskIT form to submit a support request.

title: Student Accounts
text: SFBU lists studentaccounts@sfbu.edu for the Finance Office and Student Accounts.
